warning: These are design baselines, not live availability guarantees. Every adapter must emit a model- and configuration-specific capability snapshot at runtime.

semantic_notes: Tool calls are returned as structured output items and client tools remain application-executed.
Structured outputs still require local schema and business-rule validation.
Response and conversation identifiers must not become canonical project state.
Client tool_use and provider server tools have different execution ownership.
pause_turn and model_context_window_exceeded must remain distinct from normal completion.
Structured output support varies by model and hosting surface.
Function calls are suggestions; the application executes functions and returns results.
Compositional and parallel tool behavior must be normalized without assuming one call per turn.
Transient 429 and 503 responses require bounded backoff, not silent provider switching.
Actual capabilities and data policy depend on the selected downstream provider and model.
Routing and fallback must be logged and constrained by require_parameters, region, retention, and collection policy.
Gateway compatibility does not erase downstream provider semantics.
